policy.effectText: Use Stage 2 effectName/effectText as-is. Do not summarize, rewrite, merge, or infer equipment effect wording in page data.
policy.classificationOrder: Use filterMap.groupOrder and filterMap.subtypeOrder; never raw Label numeric order.
policy.nameKr: Copy only Stage 3-2 verified nameKr. REVIEW candidates must never leak into the page list; null remains explicit and nameCn stays available as source display text.

releaseOrder.tab1: No fabricated historical order. After classification order, use sortIndex asc then equipmentId asc as deterministic fallback only.
releaseOrder.tab2: Within each group/subtype, sort known releaseGroupDate descending, then sortIndex asc and equipmentId asc. Do not invent order inside a release group.
releaseOrder.tab3: Current frozen Stage 2 output has no explicit releaseGroupDate for the 32 current-additional records. Keep release-order status REVIEW and use sortIndex/equipmentId only as deterministic fallback, never as claimed release chronology.
never: raw Label numeric order as display order
